title: Portfolio v1: manual memory management
summary: Track positions in a dynamically allocated array that you grow, search and release yourself, with new[]/delete[] and pointers. In chapter 4 you'll rebuild it as a RAII class.

steps.title: Allocate and release
hints: Reset the fields in `destroy` so a destroyed portfolio is clearly empty.

steps.title: Fills, lookup and growth
hints: `find`: walk with a pointer from `p.positions` to `p.positions + p.size`.
When `size == capacity`, allocate a twice-as-big array, copy the positions, `delete[]` the old one.
Average cost only changes on buys: `(old_qty * old_avg + qty * price) / new_qty`.

steps.title: Valuation and P&L
hints: `market_value`: for each position, look up its mark in the parallel arrays `symbols`/`marks`.
